reviewer: Agent review of actual native captures; no human participant study

criteria.clear: Named pages, visible native navigation, consistent selection and bounded dialogs; automated task gates remain separately required
criteria.convenient: Common navigation and keyboard actions remain reachable in the named layouts
criteria.user_friendly: Plain action names, independent preview/save/cancel and visible unavailable actions
criteria.graphical_quality: Consistent original vector icons, themes, spacing and measured saver title alignment
criteria.readable: Reviewed compact and real 4K captures have legible native fonts and no essential text overlap or clipped controls

scope: These representative images were individually viewed. Automated owner/caption bounds cover all 95 declared app frames; this is not a claim that an agent manually inspected every pixel of every frame. Whole-product acceptance and public delivery remain separate gates.
